# Mote v1.0.0

Mote is a minimal, local-first Markdown note app for writing and organizing notes without an account or backend.

## Highlights

- Native Markdown editing with a simple `<textarea>` and a separate Preview mode.
- Notes, groups, Inbox, Favorites, Recent, Hidden and Trash.
- Drag and drop notes into groups, Inbox and Trash on supported desktop browsers.
- Interactive task checkboxes in Preview that update the Markdown source and autosave.
- Tables, code blocks, syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, images and a formatting toolbar.
- Import individual Markdown files or import a folder of `.md` files into a matching group on supported browsers.
- Export notes as `.md`, `.txt` or print-ready `.pdf`.
- Full JSON backup and restore.
- Light, Dark and System themes with Vietnamese and English UI.
- Responsive desktop, tablet and mobile layouts.
- Installable PWA hosted on Cloudflare Pages.

## Data and privacy

Mote is local-first. Notes are stored in IndexedDB in the current browser. There is no account or backend sync in v1.0.0.

Export a JSON backup before clearing browser/site data or moving to another device.

## Try Mote

https://mote.namnth.com

## Notes

- Folder import depends on the browser's folder-upload support.
- PDF export uses the browser's native print/PDF flow so Markdown structure, tables, code, links, lists, images and Mermaid diagrams can be preserved more faithfully.
